description.value: An fMRI study of acute social stress, cortisol, and NAcc responses to subliminally presented sexual reward cues in healthy males.

value: We expected that stress-induced increased NAcc activation in response to rewarding stimuli would be mediated by cortisol.
We hypothesized that cortisol mediates the relationship between stress and NAcc activation.

value: In the contrast Sex vs Neu, four significantly activated clusters were found. One cluster had its peak activation in the left orbitofrontal cortex, encompassing local maxima in the left insula, bilateral NAcc, the left thalamus and left amygdala. Other clusters were found in the anterior cingulate cortex, the precuneus, and the right insula with a local maximum in the right amygdala.
